how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_001.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.barrier: Breaks through any barrier the weapon touches and partially breaches through armors.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.crushin: Increases a weapons damage in exchange of its durability.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.dead_en: Ideally reduce the target's Spiritual Health to 0 after 7 hits.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.element: Increases damage output of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.
Decreases damage input of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.energy_: Reduces the amount of energy stolen from the wearer.
Drains a small percent of EP from the target.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.enervat: Constantly drains the vitality from the wielder and surrounding in exchange for high magical resistance and defense.
Double the amount of Energy the weapon gains.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.holy_co: Multiplies the damage against Monster targets.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.holy_we: Imbues the weapon with holy damage.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.intangi: Completely bypasses enemies' armors and shields.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.letharg: Reduces the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_c: Allows magic items to hold more magic.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_i: Reduces Magic Damage from targets weaker than you, and partially bypasses Magic Barriers of targets.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_p: Decreases damage input of magic attacks for each piece of gear equipped.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_w: Imbues the weapon with magic damage.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magicul: Increases the amount of magicule the wearer absorbs from the environment.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.restora: Boost the item's regeneration speed using EP and XP.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.ruinati: Stops the item from regenerating and consumes any XP the wielder obtains.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.sealing: Seals the items from being enchanted or taken enchantments.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.severan: The target will receive damage which cannot be healed by regular means.
Reduces the amount of severance health dealt on the wearer.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.slottin: Allows for elemental cores to be inserted.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.soul_ea: Imbues the weapon with spiritual damage.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.spiritu: Reduces the amount of spiritual damage dealt on the wearer.
Increases the weapon's damage, armor's protection and equipments durability, and makes the item invulnerable to environmental damage.
items.lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.swift.d: Increases the weapon's damage, attack range and attack speed.
